            The following is a summary of the principal terms of the                以下為董事會透過於2024年11月26日通過
            2024 Second Share Incentive Plan conditionally adopted                  的書面決議案有條件採納的2024年第二股份

            The 2024 Second Share Incentive Plan is a share scheme                  股份資助的股份計劃，須遵守並符合上市規
            funded by existing Shares that is subject to, and complies              則第17章的適用規定。

            Purpose                                                                 目的
            The purpose of the 2024 Second Share Incentive Plan is to               2024年第二股份激勵計劃旨在為本公司提供
            provide the Company with a flexible means of remunerating,              靈活的薪酬、激勵、挽留、獎勵、補償及╱
            incentivizing, retaining, rewarding, compensating and/                  或向合資格參與者提供福利的方式；透過向
            or providing benefits to eligible participants; to align the            合資格參與者提供收購本公司股權的機會，
            interests of eligible participants with those of the Company            使彼等的利益與本公司及股東的利益一致；
            and Shareholders by providing such eligible participants                並鼓勵合資格參與者為本公司的長遠增長及

            Reasons for the transactions                                交易的理由

            The buildings owned by Wumei Group in Beijing are           物美集團在北京所擁有的樓宇位於核心
            located in the prime business districts where many          商業區，眾多科技公司於此設立總部及
            technology companies set up their headquarters and          辦公室，且鄰近公共交通。由於有關樓
            offices and are close to public transport. As such          宇具備我們辦公室所需的理想功能，我
            buildings have the desired features we required for         們與物美集團進行公平磋商，並租用位
            our offices, we engaged in arm’s length negotiations        於其樓宇的若干辦公空間。

    Dmall Inc. (the “Company”) was incorporated in the                     多點數智有限公司（「本公司」）於2015年2月5
    British Virgin Islands (“BVI”) as an exempted company with             日根據英屬維爾京群島公司法於英屬維爾京
    limited liability on February 5, 2015 under the BVI Company            群島（「英屬維爾京群島」）註冊成立為獲豁免
    Law. The Company’s shares have been listed on the Stock                有限責任公司。本公司股份自2024年12月6
    Exchange of Hong Kong Limited (“Stock Exchange”) since                 日起在香港聯合交易所有限公司（「聯交所」）
    December 6, 2024.                                                      上市。


    The Company is an investment holding company. The                      本公司為一家投資控股公司。本公司及其附
    Company and its subsidiaries (collectively, the “Group”) are           屬公司（統稱為「本集團」）主要從事為本地零
    principally engaged in providing retail digitalization solutions       售業的零售商提供零售數字化解決方案。本
    to retailers in the local retail industry. The Group’s principal       集團的主要業務及地域市場位於中華人民共
    operations and geographic markets are in the People’s                  和國（「中國」）。
    Republic of China (“PRC”).

    Group conducted internet-related business in China through             點新鮮（北京）電子商務有限公司（「多點新鮮
    Dmall Fresh (Beijing) E-Commerce Co., Ltd. (“Dmall Fresh               （北京）」）及其附屬公司多點新鮮（深圳）電子
    (Beijing)”) and its subsidiary, Dmall Fresh (Shenzhen)                 商務有限公司（「多點新鮮（深圳）」）
                                                                                            （ 統稱為
    E-commerce Co., Ltd. (“Dmall Fresh (Shenzhen)”),                       「前可變利益實體」）於中國開展互聯網相關業
    collectively, the “former VIEs”). Dmall Fresh (Beijing) and            務。多點新鮮（北京）及多點新鮮（深圳）兩者

          to purchase the convertible redeemable preferred shares if           優先股。該贖回義務亦產生金融負債。轉換
          requested by the holders. Such redemption obligation also            功能符合衍生品的定義，由於「估值下調」保
          gives rise to financial liabilities. The conversion feature meets    護功能而不符合固定換取標準，因此該轉換
          the definition of a derivative and the fixed-for-fixed criterion     功能被歸類為衍生金融負債。所有優先股均
          is not met due to the “down-round” protection feature,               被歸類為流動負債，此乃由於優先股可隨時
          thus the conversion feature is classified as a derivative            根據優先股持有人的選擇轉換為普通股，且
          financial liability. All the preferred shares were classified as     該轉換特徵不符合權益工具的定義
          current liabilities as the preferred shares may be converted
          into ordinary shares at the option of the holders at any time
          and the conversion feature does not meet the definition of
          an equity instrument.


          The convertible redeemable preferred shares are hybrid               可轉換可贖回優先股為部分具有不同的經濟
          instruments with parts that have different economic                  特徵和風險（債務與股權性質）的混合工具。
          characteristics and risks (debt vs equity nature).
